summary: Pulinbihari Chakravarti was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Jogendranath Vedantatirtha and Satkari Mookerjee. In 1951, he was attested as Curator of Manuscripts at The Asiatic Society.

Purnima Dhavan is a historian and Indologist who studied at the University of Michigan and the University of Virginia. She held posts at Bowdoin College, St. John's University, and the University of Washington, where she was appointed Associate Professor in 2005.

Purushottam Mahadev Joshi (1904–1989) was a historian who worked at the University of Mumbai Library around 1935 to 1947. He also served as Reader in Medieval History at Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute.

Purushottam Vishvanath Bapat (1894–1991) was an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who earned degrees from the University of Mumbai and Harvard. He held positions at Fergusson College, Visva-Bharati University, and held a chair in Buddhist studies at the University of Delhi.

Purushottama Bilimoria is a scholar of philosophy, Indology, and religious studies who earned his PhD from La Trobe University under Shivesh Thakur. His career includes posts at Deakin University, the University of Melbourne, UC Berkeley, Stony Brook University, and Columbia University.
Puthezathu Rama Menon (1891–1973) worked in the field of Indology. His career included serving as a judge on the Chief Court of Cochin and as president of the Kerala Sahitya Akademi.
Pyi Phyo Kyaw is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a PhD at King's College London in 2014 and later served there as a postdoctoral research fellow in 2017.

Péter-Dániel Szántó is a scholar of Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology who studied at Eötvös Loránd University and Balliol College, Oxford, under Alexis Sanderson. He has held positions at All Souls College, Oxford, the University of Oxford, and Eötvös Loránd University.
Qian Cao is a scholar of Indology and religious studies who is attested in 2026 as a PhD student and faculty member at Ghent University.

Qian Lin is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology who earned degrees from Fudan University, the University of Bristol, and the University of Washington under Collett Cox. She is attested at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem in 2026.

Qiang Ning is a scholar of history, Buddhist studies, and Sinology who completed doctoral studies under Hung Wu and Irene Winter. He has held positions at the Dunhuang Academy, San Diego State University, Yale University, and the University of Michigan.

Qichao Liang (1873–1929) was a scholar in Sinology, history, and Buddhist studies who studied under Youwei Kang. He held posts at Shiwu Xuetang, the Translation Bureau, Nankai University, Tsinghua University, and the National Library of China.

Qing Duan (1953–2022) was an Indology, Iranian, and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Peking University and the University of Hamburg under Ronald Eric Emmerick. She served as a professor at Peking University from circa 1987 to 2022.

Qingying Chen (1942–2022) was a Tibetologist and historian who studied under Wang Yao at Minzu University of China. He taught at Minzu University of China and later directed the Historical Research Institute at the China Tibetology Research Center from circa 1986 to 2012.

Qingzhi Zhu (born 1957) is a scholar in linguistics, Sinology, and Buddhist studies. He has held professorial appointments at Peking University (attested 2004) and the Education University of Hong Kong (attested 2010).
Qinni Liu is a scholar in Buddhist studies who completed a Master of Arts degree at Fo Guang University under the supervision of Kirill Solonin.
Qiwen Xiao is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a Master of Arts degree at Fo Guang University under the supervision of Yongdong Shi, attested in 2013.
Qun Dai is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Sinology who studied at Bard College under the supervision of Patricia Eichenbaum Karetzky, attested in 2016.
R. Balasubramanian (1929–2017) was a scholar of philosophy and Indology who studied under Varahur Kalyanasundara Sastri. He served as Director at the University of Madras from circa 1975 to 1989.
R. Dustin Wehr studied under Stephen Cook and Alasdair Urquhart.
